description: Creates a game in the account. It's the FIRST step: without a game there are no folders or entities. A new project ALWAYS gets a new game: never reuse an existing game because its name matches the project. If the account has a game with the same or a similar name, the call is refused with the list: ask the user whether to use that game or create a new one (suggest a different name when it is the same, so the user can tell them apart in the lists), and only call again with new_game_confirmed=true after they say so. It's born with the root folders Ambience, Sound effects, Interface, Voices and Music (named in the game's language; template adds ready-made folders by genre). sound_direction is the style that EVERY generation in the game follows (e.g. 'cartoon, dry, no reverb'); profile describes the game (genre, camera, world, tone). language sets the language of the born folders and events (the root folders and the starter events, and the template's folders); set it to the game's own language, which is usually the one the user is writing in. Omit it to follow the account's saved language. folders: the reviewed proposal from suggest_game_setup (each folder with its tab and events), created exactly like the site's "maximum refinement"; with from_ai=true the game gets no starter events (the proposal already covers the tabs). Engine godot: before touching the project, ask the user whether to bring the sounds with the plugin or only through the conversation (see the instructions). entities: the things of the game (player, enemies, items) with their events and scene path, created in the same call, so everything the user approved exists at once. kind: 'project' for anything that is not a game (a video, a podcast, an app, an ad...): the same screen and folders on the site, under Projects, with no engine and no plugin, and it never shows in Explore; omitted, a game. Returns the id, the game page (url: share it with the user), the entities and the folders created.

entities.description: The things of the game that make noise (player, enemies, items, projectiles), each with its own events, created in the same call. A folder the site assistant proposed for ONE thing (Player, Crab Enemy) goes here as an entity.

description.description: How it sounds; goes into its prompts.

durationSec.description: One-shots at least 2 s, loops at least 6 s.

external_id.description: Its engine scene (res://player/player.tscn): the plugin sync merges into this entity.

folder.description: Name of the folder it goes in (one of folders, or an existing one like Sound effects). A new name creates that folder inside Sound effects. Omitted: Sound effects.

folders.description: The folders and events to create (the proposal from suggest_game_setup, as the user approved it). Replaces template.

durationSec.description: One-shots at least 2 s, loops at least 6 s.

name.description: A folder named exactly like its tab puts its events straight in the tab.

section.description: The tab: ambience, effects, interface or music. Omitted: effects.

from_ai.description: true when folders come from suggest_game_setup: no starter events on top (Wind, Rain, Click, Error).

kind.description: project: not a game (video, podcast, app...). No engine, no plugin, no starter events.

new_game_confirmed.description: true only after the user said, in this conversation, to create a new game although the account has one with the same or a similar name.

name: create_game
title: New game
